content:
Removed cone is similar to original cone, so slant heights have same ratio as radii:

\[
\frac{\text{removed slant}}{\text{original slant}}=\frac{1}{4}
\]

Since removed slant height is \(3\) cm:

\[
\text{original slant}=4\cdot 3=12\text{ cm}
\]

Thus frustum slant height:

\[
12-3=9\text{ cm}
\]

\[
\boxed{9}
\]
